# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 70 (Bi-Vb Pc70)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc70  
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 70  
**Title (English, from literature):** Not sending away a new disciple  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Removing the newly ordained nun from her husband's locality was intended to protect her from being forcefully reclaimed, reflecting the legal reality that a husband could attempt to compel his wife to return even after her entry into the monastic order [Entrance to the Vinaya 1983; Hüsken 1997]. In the commentary (*Samantapāsādikā*), the verbal form *vūpakāsetabbo* is explained as taking the person elsewhere (*aññattha netabbo*) [Hüsken 1997].
